title: Jubilant Snappy Norwegian Cod Skillet
description: A romantic Norwegian dish featuring briny cod, snappy vegetables, and full fat sour cream, perfect for a special dinner, this recipe is also diabetic-friendly due to its balanced ingredients and portion control.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the Norwegian cod fillets to the skillet, skin side up, and cook for 3 minutes.
Flip the cod fillets over and cook for an additional 3 minutes, until cooked through.
Remove the cod from the skillet and set aside on a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium and stir in the full fat sour cream, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Simmer the sauce for 2 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Return the cod fillets to the skillet and spoon some of the sauce over the top of each fillet.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
